name: fluxmail
description: Read, search, draft, send, and organize email from Windows, macOS, or Linux.
long_description: Fluxmail connects Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP/SMTP mailboxes to a local MCP server. This bundle supports Windows and macOS on x64 and ARM64, plus Linux on x64 and ARM64 with glibc or musl. It requires Node.js 22.22 or later. Set up Fluxmail and connect a mailbox first, then install the bundle to use that local account from your MCP client. See the quickstart at https://fluxmail.ai/docs/quickstart.

permission_profile.title: Permission profile
permission_profile.description: full (default) reads, searches, sends, schedules, manages drafts, organizes mail, and moves messages into or out of Trash. read-write allows drafts, organization, and Trash but cannot send or schedule mail. read-only reads and searches mail. No profile allows permanent deletion. Scheduled delivery requires fluxmail serve or fluxmail scheduled run. Saved profiles override the default; save read-only to retain it after upgrades.
